edonadei-caliper-examples-02-tool-misuse.description: Send an operational alert. Use when asked to send an alert, page, or notification.

edonadei-caliper-examples-05-context-bou.description: Write a machine-checkable context boundary receipt from provided project context files.

edonadei-caliper-evaluate-skill.description: Run, read, and diagnose a skill's Caliper eval — its success rate over k attempts, whether it fires, and whether it beats the agent without it. Use when the user wants to run, validate, interpret, or compare a skill's eval, or write an .eval.yaml spec whose tasks they have already decided.

edonadei-caliper-grill-skill.description: Interview the user to decide what a skill's eval should test, then build the spec and iterate until the skill ships. Use when the user wants help designing a skill's eval, has a skill with no eval, or wants to find what an existing eval misses.

edonadei-caliper-examples-06-mid-convers.description: Bug-fix mode that reproduces a bug in a failing test before changing any code. Entered with /repro-first.

edonadei-caliper-examples-03-runaway-loo.description: Fetch data with a strict retry budget. Use when asked to fetch data that may be unavailable.

edonadei-caliper-examples-01-false-succe.description: Save a short note to a file. Use when asked to record, save, or jot down a note.

edonadei-caliper-examples-04-prompt-regr.description: Convert a title into a URL slug. Use when asked to slugify a title or make a URL slug.
